title: Keep legacy settings extras inert
summary: Preserve imported unknown settings as archival JSON evidence while excluding them from active PSD1 projection and PowerShell runtime variables.
reason: Remediate CSW-2026-07-09-SETTINGS-002. Legacy extras were documented as inert but were merged into generated PSD1 and assigned into script scope at runtime.
behavior_before: Unknown imported PSD1 keys were retained under legacy_extras in the JSON authority, then copied back into the active PSD1 projection and assigned as PowerShell script-scope variables.
behavior_after: Unknown imported keys remain recoverable in the JSON authority and projection-manifest evidence, while active PSD1 contains only registered settings and runtime merge ignores every noncanonical key.
tests_added: Actual PowerShell runtime merge applies representative canonical video, audio, subtitle, pending-publish, and array policy values while rejecting unknown and wrong-case names without creating script variables.
Compatibility migration retains a retired alias and a misspelled key as explicit archival evidence without promoting the misspelling.
PSD1 compatibility import preserves a laboratory-only key in JSON legacy_extras and manifest count while excluding it from active PSD1 across a fresh service reload.
Projection generation fails closed when an unregistered key is misfiled under active JSON settings, without rewriting the existing PSD1.
